text:
alex_rose: Zenith EAP NDA is in place. Summit of contacts: zenith_hw (HW), jin_choi (bench), maria_g (E2E). Can we confirm scope and initial benchmarks we want? :party-parrot:

maria_g: Confirmed. Propose baseline run: latency p50/p95, throughput at batch sizes 1/8/32, and memory footprint. I'll draft a simple harness.

jin_choi: I'll reuse the perf runner. Example command:
```
./run_bench --model redwood-v1 --seq 2048 --bs 8 --iters 100
```

sam_t: do we have kernel/quantization variants from Zenith we should test?

zenith_hw: we have two firmware flavors: 1.0 (stable) and 1.1 (opt). 1.1 improves int8 perf but needs a perf flag: --fw=1.1

dina_ops: important: telemetry + PII. All logs must be scrubbed, and telemetry goes to our S3 bucket (redwood-eap/zenith). We need signed CSV of experiments and retention TTL.

alex_rose: audit: please prepare checklist: NDA doc, test harness repo link, S3 path, expected metrics, failure modes, feedback cadence. Maria, can you own checklist?

maria_g: yes. I'll open a small repo and add CI. plan: weekly sync, daily brief channel for logs and a triage doc. @zenith_hw can you share sample model artifacts by EOD Friday?

zenith_hw: sharing link: https://zenith-files.example/zenith_redwood_sample_v1.tar.gz (internal). Will add checksums and a README for artifact compatibility.

partner-bot: deploy notification: test harness repo created at https://git.internal/rw/zenith-eap-harness

sam_t: also adding a micro-run for warm cache / cold cache comparisons:
```
./run_bench --warm_cache=false --iters 20
```

jin_choi: let's capture token-level breakdown and GPU util. Suggest use of prometheus exporter and tag runs with fw and quant flags. metrics to collect:
- redwood_latency_ms
- gpu_util_pct
- memory_bytes
- tokens_generated

dina_ops: security note: ensure KMS keys noted. Use customer-managed key: projects/zenith/kms/key1. Also redact any sample inputs that contain PII.

alex_rose: good. Next: plan for public benchmark? Not until internal EAP + signoff. We'll do an internal memo after baseline and a short exec summary for partnerships.

maria_g: I'll circulate the initial plan and checklist by tomorrow morning. Weekly sync set: Friday 11am PT. I'll include CI badge and basic runbook. :calendar:

zenith_hw: thanks all. We'll deliver firmware 1.1 image and sample models by Friday and post checksums. Happy to join Friday sync for a live run.

alex_rose: thanks everyone — recording action items: Maria=checklist+repo, Jin=metrics+runner tweaks, Sam=cache experiments, Dina=security/telemetry, Zenith=artifacts+fw. :thumbsup:
